purpose: Normalize the former V7 terminology into one professional provider-based Terrain Lane. V7 remains a compatibility/runtime provider while LPC Revised seasonal terrain, ElizaWy cliffs, LPC directional ramps, and waterfall providers are mapped into one semantic terrain authority.

namingPolicy.legacyV7Meaning: A provider/version inside the Terrain Lane, not the terrain lane itself

providers.role: direct source compatibility and pure fill reference
complete 3x4 authored directional ramp stamp provider

resolverPriority: mapped seasonal source profile when green-checked and validated
compatibilityRules: Sources are compatible through semantic/topology roles, not through assumed identical tile coordinates.
Renderer draws exact source rects from mapped records and never visually searches at runtime.
V7 remains runtime fallback until seasonal source profiles are mapped, validated, and promoted.
Cliff art is structural boundary presentation and does not replace terrain semantics.
Ramp art is a complete authored stamp/provider, not a single terrain tile.
Water details/overlays decorate after structural water topology is resolved.
mapperResponsibilities: Preload Havenwild known sheet cards from asset lane at startup without loading every full texture.
Map per-tile exact source identity, semantic role, layer role, compatibility, collision, and group membership.
Map group/topology families for shorelines, coastlines, rivers, ponds, lakes, islands, details, and overlays.
Show per-tile and per-sheet mapping status badges.
Generate correction scenes from structured sheet profiles rather than random visual scatter.
Export handoff records for native editor and later Ember ingest.
runtimeRule: Worldgen and editor code must request provider-neutral terrain roles; the Terrain Lane resolver maps those roles to exact source-profile rectangles with V7 as fallback until seasonal profiles are certified.
nextImplementationPasses: group boxing and family mapping for seasonal terrain sheets
water topology family roles for pond/lake/river/coast/island modules
collision and socket authoring per mapped group
